p: Gravesend is an old Thames-side town with more history than people realise, and New Road is part of its everyday shopping centre, a short walk from the river.

The statue of Pocahontas, who died here in 1617, stands at St George's Church, and the Town Pier and riverside are lovely on a clear day, with the ferry crossing to Tilbury close by. The Guru Nanak Darbar Gurdwara, with its gleaming white domes, is an impressive sight too. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's one for grown-ups only. The town centre has a covered market, cafés and plenty of places to eat if you want to make an afternoon of it.
